threshold_selection.source: training predictions only; frozen before out-of-time scoring

base_features.name: pct_spread
base_features.economic_rationale: Gross merger-arb spread remaining in the market.
base_features.pit_definition: (offer-known-at-feature-time - raw target close) / raw target close. Both offer valid_time/known_at and price observation/known_at must be <= feature_time.

base_features.name: delta_spread
base_features.economic_rationale: Stress as widening or tightening of the merger-arb spread.
base_features.pit_definition: First difference of PIT pct_spread using only observations knowable by feature_time.

base_features.name: spread_vol
base_features.economic_rationale: Realized instability of the spread path before the frozen snapshot.
base_features.pit_definition: Sample stdev of up to the last 10 non-null PIT delta_spread values; requires at least 3, otherwise missing.

base_features.name: n_delta_obs
base_features.economic_rationale: Transparency measure for how much realized spread path is available.
base_features.pit_definition: Count of non-null delta_spread observations knowable by feature_time.

feature_time_policy_candidates.rationale: Ten PIT-safe XNYS sessions after announcement balances early stress capture with enough path history. VOL_WINDOW_DEFAULT=10 is a maximum delta window, not a requirement for 10 deltas: ten closes can produce at most nine post-announcement deltas. spread_vol uses up to the last 10 non-null deltas and requires at least 3. Short deals are censored at T+10; their feature date is never pulled toward resolution.

frozen_policy.rationale: Ten PIT-safe XNYS sessions after announcement balances early stress capture with enough path history. VOL_WINDOW_DEFAULT=10 is a maximum delta window, not a requirement for 10 deltas: ten closes can produce at most nine post-announcement deltas. spread_vol uses up to the last 10 non-null deltas and requires at least 3. Short deals are censored at T+10; their feature date is never pulled toward resolution.

date_only_announcement_rule: DATE_ONLY announcement-day close is never a v2 feature print.
intraday_announcement_rule: Intraday announcements require an explicit UTC offset and are compared with the actual XNYS close, including early closes.
active_at_feature_time: Feature dates are generated first. Resolution known_at can only censor the frozen snapshot. Same-day DATE_ONLY or naive known_at is ORDERING_AMBIGUOUS and censored.
resolution_feature_date_rule: Resolution timestamp and resolution known_at are forbidden inputs to feature-date generation.

validation.ordering: intraday announcement chronology is normalized to UTC; DATE_ONLY ties use market date then deal_id
validation.grouping: all rows for one deal stay on one side
validation.test_labels: never used to fit preprocessing, coefficients, or threshold
validation.minimum gates: MIN_SAMPLE_N and MIN_CLASS_N are rechecked after T+10 censoring

execution.reason: methodology frozen; execution requires panel/cohort freeze, v2 implementation, and explicit authorization
